name: Zaccheus
headline: Your skin is telling on your week.
subhead: The routine, the training and the food — all of it written down in one place, and me in the chat while you run it.

inside.title: The skin routine, in order
inside.text:
Morning and night. What I use, what order it goes in, and how long to wait between steps.
Not a shelf of bottles — the actual order, which is the part nobody writes down.

inside.title: The inside half
inside.text:
Your skin is a reflection of how you treat the inside of your body. That is the whole thing I say, so this is where I show it.
What I eat, what I drink, what I cut — and what changed first when I did.

inside.title: My training week
inside.text:
What I do in the gym, in order, with the sets and the reps.
Plus the version for the weeks you only make it twice, because those weeks come.

inside.title: The chat, and I'm in it
inside.text:
Ask me anything. What to swap, why you broke out this week, whether to train through it.
The questions you'd send me in a DM, except everyone gets to read the answer.

inside.title: Live Q&A
inside.text:
Drop your question in here during the week. I take them into the live and answer them out loud, yours included.
No more hoping I catch a DM at two in the morning.

inside.title: Sundays
inside.text:
The posts I put up on a Sunday, except in here we can actually talk about them.
Not a sermon. Just the part where keeping your word to yourself is the same muscle either way.

inside.title: The month it stops working
inside.text:
A bad stretch of skin, a week you fall off, a month where nothing moves.
That is when people quit for good, and that is exactly what this is for.

inside.title: Challenges we start together
inside.text:
Everyone begins on the same day, and the board counts both the pounds lost and the percent of your own bodyweight.
So whoever you are and wherever you started, you're actually in it.

lockedLine: Whatever you join at is what you pay for as long as you stay. It goes up for the people who come later, not for you.
